name: Shady Saltseers
summary: A contact of Baron Revilgaz sends you to the Drowned City after the Saltseers, pirates who collect magical artifacts. Their stolen goods have drawn attention now that the sunken troll ruin has risen again.

sections.title: A Baron’s Request
sections.body: A contact of Baron Revilgaz asks you to recover artifacts from the Saltseers in the Drowned City. The pirates collect magical objects, and the ruin’s return has left goods there for the taking. Their stolen artifacts are what Revilgaz’s contact seeks.

faq.answer: A contact of Baron Revilgaz asks you to recover the artifacts.
The Saltseers are pirates who collect magical artifacts.
They are in the Drowned City, a sunken troll ruin that has risen again.

faq.q: What artifacts am I looking for?
faq.answer: You are asked to recover Voodoo Infused Artifacts stolen by the Saltseers.
